# Downstairs AI model transport

`llm.js` and `NOTICE.md` are copied without modification from
[EVENWaterOne/downstairs-ai](https://github.com/EVENWaterOne/downstairs-ai),
commit `41ef046fac2d3eb42d0afa3590c615bd2a931e5d`.
The JavaScript source path is `prototype-v0.2/js/llm.js`.

Upstream states © 2026 Deqing RUAN, all rights reserved, with no open-source
license currently provided. Original comments and notices are preserved.

This integration reuses model transport and the small GM/resident conversation
pattern. All characters, needs, resources, events, cards and availability come
from the Clementi game on `codex/clementi-interaction-upgrade-2026-11-03`,
under `clementi-demo`. The other project's household/world data, time system,
maps and simulator are not loaded. In particular, Clementi's Kumar and Devi
are a caregiving family; they are not the older prototype's migrant workers.
